title: Sheinbaum Announces Decree on Social Media Violence Content After Torreón School Attack; Marks Tlatelolco Anniversary
detail: At her Oct 2 morning conference Sheinbaum addressed an attack at a secondary school in Torreón, Coahuila, and said the government is preparing a decree obliging digital platforms to detect, report and promptly remove posts and comments that directly incite violence, alongside strengthened school wellness efforts such as 'El ABC de las emociones'. On the 58th anniversary of the 1968 Tlatelolco massacre she remembered the victims and ruled out repression. Culture Secretary Claudia Curiel presented a two-year results report, citing 32% growth in cultural offerings and 520,000 activities across all 32 states.
